description: GUI front-end for Microsoft Sysinternals Sigcheck to inspect file signatures, metadata, hashes, and VirusTotal results.
notes: SigcheckGUI does not include the Sysinternals command-line engine. Download Sigcheck separately from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/sysinternals/downloads/sigcheck, extract sigcheck64.exe, rename it to sigcheck.exe, and place it beside SigcheckGUI.exe.
The developer's distribution page identifies version 1.1.3 dated 2016-11-04. The program is freeware for non-commercial use only.
